basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati)
basic_details.post_name: Project Engineer, Associate Project Engineer, Assistant Project Engineer, Plant Operator, Lab Attendant
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) has officially announced the Project Staff Recruitment 2026 with 7 openings under Advertisement No. IITG/II&SI/Project Staff Rectt-2026/132. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://www.iitg.ac.in/. Candidates possessing Ph.D., Master's, Bachelor's in Engineering/Technology, ITI/Diploma in relevant disciplines, or 10th/12th pass qualifications are eligible to apply. The age limit is as per the official notification. Interested candidates can submit their online applications on or before 07 August 20

qualification.education_qualification: PhD/ Master's/ Bachelor's in Engineering/Technology, ITI/ Diploma in relevant disciplines, 10th/ 12th pass
qualification.details: Project Engineer: PhD in Engineering/Technology, or Master's degree with minimum 3 years of relevant experience; or Bachelor's degree with minimum 6 years of relevant experience, preferably in Chemical, Mechanical, Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related disciplines. Minimum 3 years of experience in multidisciplinary R&D or technology-development projects. Proficiency in process modelling, AI/ML, data science, sensor-data analysis, software-tool development, data validation, and pilot-plant integration. Associate Project Engineer: Master's degree in Engineering/Technology or Bachelor's degree with minimum 3 years of relevant experience, preferably in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Production, Energy, Environmental, or related disciplines. Experience in material characterization, product-quality evaluation, interpretation of analytical results, and preparation of technical reports. Assistant Project Engineer: Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology, preferably in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Production, Environmental, or related disciplines. Basic knowledge of mechanical systems, equipment operation, maintenance coordination, troubleshooting, and electrical systems. Plant Operator: ITI or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Instrumentation, Production Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience in reactor, furnace, boiler, thermal-processing, or pilot-plant operation. Ability to operate continuous and batch pyrolysis reactors in rotational shifts. Lab Attendant: 10th/12th, ITI, or Diploma in a relevant discipline. Previous experience in laboratory or industrial environments is desirable. Knowledge of good laboratory practices, safety procedures, material handling, waste segregation, and spill management.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff posts is 07 August 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Staff at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for Project Staff posts announced by IIT Guwahati in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Guwahati Project Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Staff positions at IIT Guwahati will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Staff positions ranges from Rs. 17,500 to Rs. 52,000 per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: For the Project Engineer post, a PhD in Engineering/Technology or a Master's degree with 3 years of experience, or a Bachelor's degree with 6 years of experience is required.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates with ITI or Diploma apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with ITI or Diploma in relevant disciplines are eligible for posts like Plant Operator and Lab Attendant.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the IIT Guwahati Project Staff positions?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official website of IIT Guwahati or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date.
